verdicts_or_reports.element: Editor text after tapping the Unordered list toolbar action
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With Unordered list character set to Asterisk (*), tapping Unordered list on an empty line should insert '* '.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: It inserts '- ' instead. Reproduced twice after selecting Asterisk in Edit Mode settings and reopening the editor.
steps: Open More > Settings > Edit Mode > Unordered list character.
Open Indent.md from Files; its contents are '- item' and an indented '- child'.
Tap the empty line after the list, then tap the Unordered list toolbar button.
Observe that the new line contains '- ' instead of '* '. Repeat after toggling the first insertion off.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Editor text after tapping the Unordered list toolbar action on the indented child item
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The action should recognize the existing indented '- ' marker and toggle it off, as it does for the unindented '- item' line.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: It adds another '- ' marker to the indented child line on each tap, producing '  - - - child' after two taps.
steps: Open Indent.md, containing '- item' and an indented '  - child'.
Tap the Unordered list toolbar action twice.
Observe the existing marker is not detected and repeated markers are added.
